To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we clarified the link-level performance and influence of ETV of downlink NOMA with CWIC receiver.

(a) CWIC receiver can achieve the same performance of ideal SIC for the case of 1-by- 2 transmission and the allocated power to cell-center UE of less than 0, 35, (b) the degradation due to EVM of NOMA is almost the same for OFDMA, and (c) the required SNR increases for cell-edge UE when the cell-center uses a higher order of modulation.
the link-level performance for NOMA with SLC receiver considering the influence of ERM is clarified.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the link level performance of downlink NOMA considering EVM.
the link-level performance evaluation of NOMA considering the influence of EVA.
the link-level performance evaluation of downlink NOMA with CWIC receiver and EVM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
NOMA can be used for cell-edge UE with the same EVM requirement as that of OFDMA when the allocated transmit powers to the UEs are appropriately set and when the target BLER is set to 10 %.
NOMA can achieve a performance close to ideal SIC when cell-edge UE is not in a deep fade, the EVM is small, and the power allocation is optimized.
NOMA is a very attractive technique to increase the cell-edge throughput, and the influence of ETV is almost the same for NOMA as for OFDMA, which is an important finding.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, for the case where a 1-by-M transmission is applied to downlink NOMA, the influence of ERM is small and it is important to consider the target BLER when selecting the MCS of NOMA UES, especially for the case of higher order modulation.
the link-level performance for the downlink NOMA with CWIC receiver can be improved by considering the influence of ETV.

the performance of the downlink NOMA system with SIC receiver is almost same as the ideal SIC receiver, when the allocated power ratio between cell-center UE and cell-edge UE is below 0,37, the EVM value is below 4%, and the modulation order of cell-center UE, which is the higher order modulation, is 64QAM or less.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NOMA is a promising candidate for the next-generation wireless communication system.
, in order for BS to select the MCS and allocated power ratio of UEs, the target BLER should be set to be less than 10 % and the influence of ETV on the link performance of NOMA should be considered.

, for the case that the allocated power ratio is 0.35 or less, CWIC receiver can achieve the same performance as that of ideal receiver when the EVM value is less than 5 % and the target BLER is 10 %.
